tools.name: compact
tools.description: Ask a session to summarise itself, then continue it in a new session file that points back at it. The old file is never changed except by the two turns this writes into it. With `brief=latest` the brief is rendered from the last accepted `handoff` call already in that session's ledger — the path a driver takes when the model handed off; with `brief_file` it is read from a file the caller wrote. Both of those leave the old session byte-identical and fork at its current tail. Either way the carried text ends with a pointer back to the parent session. Returns the new session id.

session.description: The session to compact; it must not be running a step.

focus.description: Extra emphasis for the brief. Supplements the required sections, never replaces them. Ignored when the brief already exists.

max_steps.description: Steps the summarising run may take (1-3, default 1). Ignored when the brief already exists.

brief.description: `latest`: take the brief from the last `handoff` call this session's ledger recorded and the kernel accepted. The old session is left byte-identical.

brief_seq.description: Take the brief from the `handoff` call at this ledger seq instead of the newest one. The fork point is the ledger's tail either way.

brief_file.description: Path (workspace-relative or absolute) to a brief that already exists. Given, the old session is left byte-identical and only the fork happens.
